proposal: With existing reducer_plan_cache true, remember a plan only after one complete scan finds no work. Skip per-attempt scans while that exact cached publication object is current; always retain active publication checks. New publication invalidates; exceptions and partial scans do not mark exhaustion. Legacy cache-disabled behavior unchanged.
